data.name: Karan
data.gender_notes: Karan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit karṇa, 'ear'. Its root is Sanskrit karṇa (कर्ण). A classical Sanskrit name. Karan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ear; (also) a warrior's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Karan expresses “Ear; (also) a warrior's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karan total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
